name: calm-mode
description: Calm Mode: hides tool calls and shows one friendly checklist above the prompt while Claude works.

hideToolRows.title: Hide tool rows
hideToolRows.description: While Calm Mode is on, hide tool calls, their output and progress hints. Off keeps the checklist but shows every row.

jobNaming.title: Job naming
jobNaming.description: Ask Haiku for a short 2 to 6 word name for each new request. Off saves that small call and uses your first line instead.

buttonLabel.title: Button label
buttonLabel.description: The words on the on/off button, up to 20 characters.

cyberpunk.title: Cyberpunk theme
cyberpunk.description: Neon pink titles, cyan meters and yellow alerts.

music.title: Cyberpunk music
music.description: Play background music while Claude works, only when the Cyberpunk theme is on.

musicFile.title: Music file
musicFile.description: Full path to your own MP3 or WAV. Leave empty for the built-in synth loop.

musicVolume.title: Music volume
musicVolume.description: Background music volume from 0 to 100 percent.

track.title: Music track
track.description: Built-in track to play when no music file is set; shuffle picks a random one each job.

awayRecap.title: Away recap
awayRecap.description: After a job, if you have been away for a while, show a Welcome back card with what Claude did and what you last asked.

awayMinutes.title: Away after (minutes)
awayMinutes.description: Minutes of quiet after a job before the Welcome back card appears (1 to 120).

clock.title: Clock
clock.description: Show the date and time (24-hour, your time zone) beside the weather at the band's right (time only when the band is narrow).

nextSteps.title: Next steps
nextSteps.description: After Claude answers, suggest up to three next prompts above the input (one small Haiku call, none when Claude just asked a yes or no question). Press 1 to 3 in an empty prompt to use one.

recapStyle.title: Recap style
recapStyle.description: Where the Welcome back recap reads: band (above the prompt, fitted to its rows) or pane (a larger panel of its own, with the job's steps).

weatherCity.title: Weather city
weatherCity.description: A city for the weather, e.g. "Khon Kaen" (found with Open-Meteo's place search). Leave blank to work it out from your internet address, which can be off by a city or more.

weather.title: Weather
weather.description: Show your city, a weather symbol and the temperature beside the gear, e.g. "📍 Bangkok ⛅ 31°C". Your city is looked up from your internet address (ipwho.is) at most once an hour; the reading comes from Open-Meteo every 15 minutes.

cacheMeter.title: Cache in status line
cacheMeter.description: Whether the cache meter is in your status line. Change it with the button in the settings row or /calm statusline on|off, which edit your status line for you.

autoKeepWarm.title: Auto keep warm
autoKeepWarm.description: Turn keep warm on by itself after an answer once the chat holds this many tokens (Auto keep warm from). It stops after 3 pings in a row, about 3 hours away, and stays off for the session once you turn keep warm off. Needs the cache meter in your status line and the 1-hour cache.

autoKeepWarmK.title: Auto keep warm from (thousand tokens)
autoKeepWarmK.description: The chat size, in thousands of tokens, at which auto keep warm turns on (10 to 500). Bigger chats cost more to rebuild, so keeping them warm saves more.
